title: Independently audit selected compiler ordering and owner guards
body:
## Summary

```text
research/physical-compiler-correspondence/
  README.md       conditional ordering proof and exact scope
  owners.py       selected all-low matrix-separation audit
  semantics.py    symbolic packets through retained Driver and compiled dispatch
  verify.py       source-bound replay and admission/fault controls
```

Independent audit of PR2809's opcode/source-correspondence handoff, task `supplier-boundary-audit`, priority revision 5. The package adds no production edits or selected-frontier changes.

- A conditional whole-word ordering lemma, retaining complete residual/primitive contracts.
- Direct reconstruction of 463 chart-pair coordinate witnesses covering all 181,056 selected same-family owner pairs. Differences ±1 or ±1/2 imply separation at every odd source prime where the charts are invertible, for every GL64 common low.
- Exact compiler/source admission counterexamples for duplicate owners and self-bridges. These are inadmissible fixtures, not selected-construction failures.

Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml's PR2195/2753 and ywz65's whole-packet staging package already establish support separation and the owner/pair counts. Their credit is retained. This contribution independently checks the actual compiler chart matrices and the actual Driver/dispatcher ordering, not those historical counts as a new discovery.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the compiler omits two source-driver admission guards. Final/global endpoints also miss deletion of a cancelling private-XOR pair.
- **After:** registered replay reconstructs eight complete abstract-packet words, 67,024 instructions and 8,064 residual boundaries. It detects all five word defects, both invalid admission cases and missing/zero chart witnesses. Literal dispatch, latest-family scatter and source-corruption controls pass.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/physical-compiler-correspondence
```

Normal and optimized CPython 3.12.15 replay pass eight behavioral groups each on Linux/WSL2. Optimized CPython 3.13 also passes. Workflow suite: 158 tests, 16 platform skips. Ruff lint/format and exact publication-byte checks pass, covering 126 files.

Exact artifact head: `133cd8a7c5ce16a3d66e3372c5fdd9e88067d75b`. Canonical main refreshed to unchanged `b3f3ee0392b71b118fd086a6eaf6b4cab54ef455`; submission overlap has complete metadata pagination over 232 open PRs, 2,440 closed/merged PRs and 1,689 Discussion records, with no warnings. Arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain excluded. [Canonical coordination](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18977492).

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. This is an isolated research package with an explicit bounded replay hook.

**Blast Radius:** local. Frozen predecessors, shared code and the selected result remain unchanged.

The symbolic replay substitutes packet kernels, node/merge and residual bodies. It is not physical Tape or selected GL64 execution. Residual/CALL refinement, scratch/storage, movement, precision, complete costs and supplier admission remain open. No full selected cold replay, formal-kernel check, hosted-CI pass, independent human review or new kappa is claimed. Open next questions and exact source pins are in the package. Substantial automated assistance was used.
